mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, which in turn results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real GDP indicates strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 shows a sustained 3-month increase.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals economic weakness, leading to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in industrial production by more than 1% within a month signals a reduction in supply-side capacity, leading to lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 1% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures signals strong consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS show increases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate signals a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index over 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to increased costs for businesses and reduced real earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL shows a sustained 3-month increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures combined with a decrease in housing starts signals a weakening demand, leading to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST show decreases.
